fields.description: 8-byte save banner at SRAM 0, verified against baseline bytes 'STAFY OK'.
fields.evidence: FUN_080018a4 reads 8 bytes at SRAM offset 0 via FUN_08003e0c and compares each byte against the expected banner at DAT_080018fc (rewrite default from DAT_08001900); baseline file 0x00..0x07 = 53 54 41 46 59 20 4F 4B.
fields.name: save_banner

fields.description: First byte of the 300-byte slot-A RAM save buffer; FUN_08001cdc branches on it being zero vs nonzero.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001cdc loads pcVar2 = DAT_08001d18 and tests *pcVar2 == 0 before writing 300 bytes via FUN_08003e48 to SRAM 0x10; baseline file 0x10 = 0x00.
fields.name: slot_a_present

fields.description: Second byte of the slot-A RAM save buffer, initialized to 0 on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b04 with param_1 == 0 selects RAM buffer DAT_08001b74 and SRAM offset 0x10, then stores 0 at buffer +1 via FUN_08003e0c (300-byte SRAM read); baseline file 0x11 = 0x00.
fields.name: slot_a_init_zero

fields.description: Slot-A RAM save buffer byte +0x0A, initialized to 5 on load; live-mutable scalar.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b04 stores 5 at (DAT_08001b74 + 10) then FUN_08003e0c reads 300 bytes from SRAM 0x10; baseline file 0x1A (= 0x10 + 0x0A) = 0x05 verifies.
fields.name: slot_a_init_five

fields.description: Four 0xFF bytes at slot-A RAM save buffer +0x34..+0x37, set by the init loop on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b04 loop stores 0xFF at (DAT_08001b74 + 0x34 + uVar2) for uVar2 in 0..3, then FUN_08003e0c reads 300 bytes from SRAM 0x10; baseline file 0x44..0x47 = FF FF FF FF verifies.
fields.name: slot_a_ff_fill

fields.description: Second byte of the slot-B RAM save buffer, initialized to 0 on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b04 with param_1 == 1 selects RAM buffer DAT_08001b24 and SRAM offset 0x810, then stores 0 at buffer +1 via FUN_08003e0c (300-byte SRAM read); baseline file 0x811 = 0x00.
fields.name: slot_b_init_zero

fields.description: Slot-B RAM save buffer byte +0x0A, initialized to 5 on load; live-mutable scalar.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b04 stores 5 at (DAT_08001b24 + 10) then FUN_08003e0c reads 300 bytes from SRAM 0x810; baseline file 0x81A (= 0x810 + 0x0A) = 0x05 verifies.
fields.name: slot_b_init_five

fields.name: slot_b_ff_fill

fields.description: Low half of the 4-byte config word at SRAM 0x1000, initialized to 0; live-mutable scalar.
fields.evidence: FUN_080021a4 zeroes DAT_080021cc[0] then FUN_08003e0c reads 4 bytes from SRAM 0x1000; baseline file 0x1000..0x1001 = 00 00 verifies.
fields.name: cfg_word_lo

fields.description: High half of the 4-byte config word at SRAM 0x1000, initialized to 0x80; store path branches when it differs.
fields.evidence: FUN_080021a4 sets DAT_080021cc[1] = 0x80 then FUN_08003e0c reads 4 bytes from SRAM 0x1000; FUN_080021d0 writes DAT_08002204 to SRAM 0x1000 and takes the alternate path if buffer[1] != 0x80; baseline file 0x1002..0x1003 = 80 00 verifies.
fields.name: cfg_word_hi
